node.title: E1 finite direct-value fullness compiler
node.statement: For every admissible clean-anchor row in the pair-feasible class |F_p(Q)|>=b_pair_min(K,B*), with actual quotient order N in {256,512} and class count K=A_2(N,ell), the exact collision-pair bound from e1_official_prime_exception_control implies that the reduced ambient E1 image has size at least B*+1 and supplies a direct-value V payload at agreement k+n/N. All field, embedding, owner, and endpoint pins remain mandatory.
node.notes: FINITE CORRECTION 2026-07-26: the former o(1)-sparse statement was not an exact finite prize certificate.
